title: Photolysis lifetimes at 1 AU of the species a comet or an atmosphere loses to the stellar far ultraviolet
basis: Optically thin, unshielded, 1 AU from the quiet Sun. beta = 1/lifetime_s is photodissociation plus photoionisation; beta_diss and beta_ion are [R1873] (Leiden database) rates times 37692 for the quiet-period solar field. ratio_4000k and ratio_10000k are the dissociation rate around a 4000 K and a 10000 K blackbody divided by the solar rate at equal 91.2 to 200 nm flux ([R1873: Table 18], COMPUTED); the Sun is 1. uv_cross_section_cm2 is the mean cross section over the UV the species is photolysed by (Hu 2012 table 6), which sets the column that absorbs the light (1 / sigma, optical depth 1).

H2O.lifetime_source: [R2040] quiet Sun (as coded in sbpy); range up to the unshielded [R1873] total
H2O.uv_cross_section_source: Hu, [R2026] table 6, mean UV cross section, read; atmosphere-composition-parts/04-photochemistry-lifetimes-escape.md section 2.5

CO.lifetime_source: quiet Sun; another source gives 1.54e6; [R1873] total 1.83e6
CO.uv_cross_section_source: none read: the species has no mean cross section in the sources, so no shielded column

NH3.lifetime_source: [R0407] (Odin) 6700 s; [R1844] 5.4e3 to 5.8e3; 7.0e3 to 7.7e3; [R1873] rate 1.5e-4 per s with the cross section reproduces 6.7e3 s
NH3.activity_source: COMPUTED (GEN.794, 2026-10-30, scripts/nh3_activity_factor.py): the photodissociation cross section of the Leiden database (from [R3889], Wu 2007) times the daily 1 nm solar irradiance of SORCE SOLSTICE, UARS SUSIM and UARS SOLSTICE (M. DeLand, NASA GSFC), 120 to 230 nm, each instrument's strongest year over its weakest year: 1.066, 1.083 and 1.060, mean 1.070. The quiet rate with SORCE in 2008 is 1.542e-4 per s and the active 1.644e-4 per s at 1 AU. Replaces the Boss-supplied 1.078 (1.80e-4 and 1.94e-4 per s attributed to [R2040, R2041], never read; it sits inside the computed range). Limits: no instrument measures below 120 nm; the Huebner and Mukherjee active Sun is stronger than any measured cycle maximum (H2O 1.68 against 1.33 by the earlier lane's method), so on their scale the factor could reach 1.15; bracket 1.05 to 1.15. His quiet lifetime 5.56e3 s is not adopted: the 5.6e3 s of [R2041] is a quiet and active mean and the verified [R1873] rate gives 6.7e3 s
NH3.note: the 5.6e3 s of [R2041] is a quiet and active mean, not the quiet Sun
NH3.uv_cross_section_source: Hu, [R2026] table 6, mean UV cross section, read; atmosphere-composition-parts/04-photochemistry-lifetimes-escape.md section 2.5
